published.source: Shaman PR (client 1.60.1.70425: new talent tree with Elemental Mastery, Fire Nova cut, Lava Burst and Mana Tide ranks, searched talents, 2026-10-16)

summary: The default Elemental build with 16 Restoration points for Mana Tide Totem, cast at 20% mana for the group. 1.4% behind at 180s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -5.4s, Mana Spring Totem at -3.9s, Lightning Bolt at -2.9s (lands 0.1s after the pull), Searing Totem at -0.9s
Elemental Mastery and the other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion, Land Mine) as they come up
Mana Tide Totem at 20% mana or less
Mana Spring Totem when it is down, Mana Tide is not up and at least 20s remain
Searing Totem when it is down and at least 20s remain
Flame Shock whenever its DoT is down
Lava Burst on cooldown, unless Flame Shock would run out before the cast ends
Earth Shock once a Lightning Bolt would no longer land before the fight ends
Lightning Shield when it is down, above 50% mana with at least 60s left (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 1 a minute)
Lightning Bolt rank 10 as filler (no Chain Lightning on one target)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 37 spell power and 14 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Mana Tide Totem costs the shaman 1.4 DPS: a 3 min fight with a potion and rune doesn't need the mana.
The Water Shield point does nothing (the rotation keeps Lightning Shield up).
Lightning Bolt X's base damage is ×1.12, the raise a beta build gave the top playable rank. The client's 31+ ranks look untuned (rank 10 has about 201 base at a 0.714 coefficient).
Only the Tier 1 2-piece is active. The 5-piece (Lava Burst -1s cooldown) would add more.
One 2% crit elixir per character. Owl on top of Sages would add about 10 if Forever allows it.
Raid damage hits on the shaman (1 a minute, each fires Lightning Shield) are estimated from boss timers. The assumptions panel also runs 0 and 10.
Call of Thunder is gone from the 70425 tree, so Elemental Mastery took its point. Eye of the Storm 3 keeps 70% of casts from being pushed back by the 2 raid hits a minute.
notes: mksettings -spec ele -apl level60_mana_tide (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid has none, the shaman drops Mana Spring Totem itself); race SkyborneWindshaper (the best race since client 70425's Wind Blessed 3% haste).
